activity_summary: The afternoon was Richard the Third, at two of the clock. You were dead by the third act, and the gown was off by four. Your side was an old man's. This was not the queen's garden from the morning.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the gown, and left the plot as the afternoon's.

entities.name: Richard the Third
entities.context: Mentioned in Out of the gown

facets.activity: Came out of the gown by four
